title: Integrate log writing into loop runner
description: After the loop exits for any reason, call appendSessionLog() with a summary of the session including task info, backend, iterations completed, outcome, and total elapsed time.
acceptanceCriteria: appendSessionLog() is called when loop exits via <complete>
appendSessionLog() is called when loop exits via <blocked>
appendSessionLog() is called when loop exits via max-iterations
Session log contains correct task ID, title, backend name, iteration count, outcome, and elapsed time
.agent/logs/LOG.md is updated after every loop session

steps.details: At the start of runLoop: `const loopStartMs = Date.now()`
Maintain variables: `let outcome: SessionLog['outcome'] = 'max-iterations'; let completedIterations = 0`. Update these as the loop progresses.

In the finally block (alongside caffeinate cleanup): `await appendSessionLog(options.agentDir, { taskId: options.task.id, taskTitle: options.task.title, backend: options.backend.name, iterations: completedIterations, outcome, elapsedMs: Date.now() - loopStartMs, timestamp: new Date() })`

technicalNotes: The finally block is the right place for cleanup — it runs regardless of how the generator exits
